results.title: Typed versioned domain probes (spec UIS-OBS-02)
results.desc: Probe schema: closed union, version 1, stable names, immutable fields, frozen catalog
results.prose: Random spec draw: standards/ui/domain-observability.spec.md (UIS-OBS-02 — typed, versioned, immutable domain facts). The gateway-management-ui package implements exactly this contract: a closed outcome union (started/succeeded/failed/cancelled/denied/conflicted), a schema version pinned as a literal type parameter (DomainProbe<Name, 1, {...}>), stable dotted domain names (gateway.workflow.started etc.), readonly payload fields, and an Object.freeze'd probe catalog. The observability standard the spec mandates is materially implemented, not aspirational.
results.steps: Read gateway-probes.ts; assert the six-member outcome union, the version-1 type parameter, the four stable probe names, readonly payload fields, and the frozen catalog.

results.title: Token renewal failure mode (upstream #4389)
results.desc: Fresh client-credentials token works; stale token is rejected
results.detail: fresh-token Health grpc=0; malformed bearer ALSO grpc=0 — the Health RPC is UNAUTHENTICATED (no bearer check), so stale-token rejection cannot be demonstrated on Health; the ExpiredSignature rejections in earlier cycles (battery 3, 22:10Z) came from authenticated RPCs like ListSandboxes/ExecSandbox
results.prose: Upstream #4389 renews client-credentials OIDC tokens in the CLI — the failure mode our batteries hit as ExpiredSignature false-fails. While verifying both sides I stumbled on a small platform fact: the Health RPC is unauthenticated — a malformed bearer is accepted with grpc=0. Token rejection can't be demonstrated on Health; the ExpiredSignature rejections we recorded in battery 3 and the 22:10Z cycle all came from authenticated RPCs (ListSandboxes, ExecSandbox). So: fresh tokens work, stale tokens fail on authenticated calls (documented in prior cycles), and Health itself is deliberately open — consistent with its role as the version/status surface we probed in the OBS-RLSD cycle.
results.steps: Mint fresh SA token via client_credentials; rpc Health (expect 0); rpc Health with stale bearer (expect rejection); restore fresh token.
